title: Complete-intersection local algebras over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $A$ be a commutative local $k$-algebra essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. It is a complete-intersection local algebra over $k$ if there are a commutative regular local $k$-algebra $R$ [def-weil-regular-scheme] essentially of finite type over $k$, and a finite regular sequence $f_1,\ldots,f_c$ in the maximal ideal of $R$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], such that $R/(f_1,\ldots,f_c)\cong A$ as $k$-algebras. The empty regular sequence is allowed.
